=   You translate Hyundai India customer feedback. Rewrite the customer text below in plain English, keeping every complaint, car part and emotion. If it is already English, return it unchanged. Return only the rewritten text.
   Customer text: {{ $json.review_text }}

parameters.content: **Score Review** – This workflow scores one customer complaint and is used by both Claude and the chatbot. It receives the complaint text and the car model, then sends the text to Google Gemini, which translates Hindi or Hinglish into plain English (if Gemini is busy or fails, the original text is used so the tool never stops). The Code node then applies our business rules: it finds which of 12 topics the customer is talking about (gearbox, AC, sunroof, service and so on), scores the tone from −1 (very negative) to +1 (very positive), sets the urgency, flags safety and churn risks, and names the team that should act. To add a new topic or change a team, edit the THEMES and OWNER lists at the top of the code. Website: [Customer Voice Hub](https://claude.ai/artifact/5zcaETuNP1thw1ksJPTWLv)
